text: {"assertions":["A stale state bug in ui/state/cacheSlice.ts was fixed on 2026-01-23, where an old value persisted in the store snapshot.","The root cause of the stale state bug was an error being swallowed by a bare except clause in the cache slice handler.","The fix involved narrowing the error handler and allowing failures to propagate rather than being silently caught.","The fix was submitted as PR #4257 on branch fix/stale-state-1.","The stale state issue could be reproduced by editing a record and then navigating back to the list.","The bug only appeared on the staging read replica environment.","The fix reduced memory usage from over 7 GB down to 84 MB, indicating a significant memory leak was resolved.","This work continued from earlier stale state work in the same corner of the codebase."]}
